title: Secret Killer Leads Cops Into Her $3,000,000 Murder Mansion

beats.description: Cold open: officer reacts to decomposition odor, narrator sets up the mystery of Craig's hidden body and the killer's meticulous cover-up.
Introduces Craig and Dena Thatford, their lifestyle, and the first welfare check call from friend Larry Scott.
Second welfare check from grandson Cody reveals Craig missing for 4 months; Dena's story about Mexico and divorce emerges.
Neighbor interviews, Dena's phone call with deputy where she claims Craig is in Mexico; inconsistencies noted.
Detective Curtis assigned; ex-husbands and daughter reveal Dena's violent history, threats, and alcoholism.
Financial motive uncovered: Dena spent hundreds of thousands, bought new house and car; suspicion of homicide solidifies.
Deputy Roger visits Dena; she shows a note supposedly from Craig; claims she can't access safe with $1.5M.
Roger reveals his homicide background; neighbor interviews confirm Dena had safe combination and Craig feared her.
Second visit: Roger finds Dena digging a hole; Dena makes incriminating statement; she vanishes afterward.
Tip from ex-coworker: Dena admitted shooting Craig; Dena attempts suicide; search warrant obtained.
Police execute search warrant at the mansion; find bleach, disabled cameras, blood traces; safe opened with far less money.
Daughter Leslie reveals Dena confessed: Craig pushed her, she shot him, wrapped body, hid it with tractor in carport.
Body discovered under cardboard in carport; identified as Craig Thatford with multiple gunshot wounds.
Dena found at hospital, arrested without incident; invokes right to lawyer during questioning.
Case status update: Dena charged with first-degree murder and tampering; pre-trial phase; faces life in prison.
